rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: HARkuly
Exhibition name: Margaret Merril
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, before 1977).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1977 as 'Margaret Merril'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend, pink center. Strong, citrus, spice fragrance. 18 to 29 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, semi-double (9-16 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dark green foliage.

Height: 30" to 5' (75 to 150cm). Width: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 10b. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).

colour: White or white blend, pink center.
